edit.description: PostToolUse shell edge takes each finding's resolved mode
shell_edge_findings and manifest_write_findings resolve member, then kind, then root
dial softening reads the member's resolved mode, not the root's
EnforcementModes lookup the three sites share
member-mode cases at the three sites

summary: the shell edge, the co-owned manifest write binding and the dial-softening decision follow each finding's member mode (member, then kind, then root), as the pre-write guard already does
acceptance: a member declaring block under a warn root is blocked at the shell edge and the manifest write, and its dial softening is inert; a member declaring note under a block root is recorded only
tests: a shell edge finding on a member declaring block refuses the result under a warn root
a manifest write finding follows the member's declared mode
a member declaring block does not take dial softening under a warn root
notes: From PER-MEMBER-ENFORCEMENT-MODE's note. Mode semantics: specs/distribution.md, "The placements and their enforcement modes". A shell call carrying findings of several modes refuses where any is block; each finding surfaces where its own mode sends it.
